parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the product set $\mathcal{P}$.

parameters.name: num_resources
parameters.description: Number of resources in the resource set $\mathcal{R}$.

parameters.name: resource_usage
parameters.description: Resource usage coefficient for each resource-product pair.

parameters.name: demand_upper_bound
parameters.description: Market demand upper bound for each product.

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit of the production plan.

constraints.name: integer_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities are integer-valued and nonnegative for each product.

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities are nonnegative for each product.

constraints.name: nonnegative_demand_upper_bound
constraints.description: Demand upper bounds are nonnegative for each product.

constraints.name: nonnegative_resource_capacity
constraints.description: Resource capacities are nonnegative for each resource.

constraints.name: nonnegative_resource_usage
constraints.description: Resource usage coefficients are nonnegative for each resource-product pair.

constraints.name: demand_limit
constraints.description: Production of each product does not exceed its market demand upper bound.

constraints.name: resource_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total resource consumption across all products does not exceed available capacity for each resource.

constraints.name: single_period_decision
constraints.description: Production decisions are made for a single period only.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit of the single-period production plan

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit of the single-period production plan.
